items.title: The Dior Saddle bag
items.alt: A restored and embellished Dior Saddle bag, made aboard during the Pacific crossing.
items.text: A 2001 Dior Saddle bag, restored over 78 hours of night watches on the Pacific crossing. Charms, her grandmother’s nautical buttons, and milagros.

items.title: Finding my art again
items.alt: A beaded bag in progress, photographed at sea.
items.text: A beaded bag, started again after the business closed. The work is the point.

items.title: One of a kind
items.alt: An embellished one-of-a-kind bag held up to the light.
items.text: An embellished bag, one of a kind, finished aboard.

items.title: In the dinghy
items.alt: Meghan holding a finished embellished bag in the dinghy.
items.text: The finished bag, in the dinghy. Made because she wanted to make it.
